references.text: A parallel account of the conquest of Debir, formerly called Kiriath-Sepher, is found in the book of Judges
Joshua and the Israelites conquered Debir during the southern campaign, providing background for this later account
Debir is mentioned as one of the cities where Joshua wiped out the Anakim from the hill country
Debir, also called Kiriath-Sannah, is listed among the cities given to the tribe of Judah
Debir was later given to the Levites as one of their designated cities
